'''Diew Rejeff''' was a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Swang's Swoopers]] gang led by [[Mossol]] kidnapped Diew Rejeff.
